description:
As a customer, I want to search so I can find a tool quickly.

* A search term matching existing products → only matching products are listed.
* A term with no matches → an empty state message, no error.
* Search is case-insensitive.
* Clearing the search restores the full product list.

Search matches product names (partial, case-insensitive)

criteria.text: A search term matching existing products → only matching products are listed.
A term with no matches → an empty state message, no error.
Clearing the search restores the full product list.

cases.title: Search term matching existing products lists only those products
cases.preconditions: The product list contains <at least one product whose name contains the search term> and <at least one product whose name does not contain the search term>. The product list page is open and the search field is empty.
steps: Note the names of all products shown in the full product list.
Enter <a term contained in the name of at least one product> in the search field.
Compare the listed products with the names noted in step 1.
cases.expected: Only the products whose names contain the search term are listed. Products whose names do not contain the term are not listed.

cases.title: Search term with no matches shows an empty state message and no error
cases.preconditions: The product list contains at least one product. The product list page is open and the search field is empty.
steps: Enter <a term that is not contained in any product name> in the search field.
Observe the result area of the page.
cases.expected: No products are listed and an empty state message is shown (exact wording not specified in the story). No error is shown.

cases.title: Search in different letter case returns the same products
cases.preconditions: The product list contains <a product whose name contains both upper- and lower-case letters>. The product list page is open and the search field is empty.
steps: Enter <part of that product's name typed in all lower case> in the search field and apply the search.
Note the products that are listed.
Enter the same term typed in all upper case and apply the search.
Compare the listed products with the ones noted in step 2.
cases.expected: Both searches list the same matching products; the result does not depend on the letter case used in the search term.

cases.title: Clearing the search restores the full product list
cases.preconditions: The product list contains <at least two products with different names>. The product list page is open and the search field is empty.
steps: Note the names of all products shown in the full product list.
Enter <a term contained in the name of only some of the products> in the search field and apply the search.
Confirm that fewer products are now listed.
cases.expected: The full product list is shown again, matching the names noted in step 1.

cases.title: Partial product name matches
cases.preconditions: The product list contains <a product whose name is more than one word or several characters long, e.g. so that a fragment from the middle of the name can be used>. The product list page is open and the search field is empty.
steps: Enter <a fragment of that product's name, not the complete name and not its beginning> in the search field.
cases.expected: The product whose name contains that fragment is listed; a partial name is enough to match.
